findings.description: Lane rules and operations have scattered owners
Lane admission rejects healthy units for unrelated row errors
Queue imports shared state from the delivery command

Lane writer disagrees with reader table forms and line ending preservation
Standalone dependency checks skip missing joined-unit Lane data
